evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Lingjiao Chen, Matei Zaharia, and James Zou
evidence_items.locator: Section 3.6, LangChain HotpotQA Agent: Poor Prompt Stability; accompanying code-generation results in section 3.5
evidence_items.explanation: Comparisons of March and June model versions document formatting failures that prevented code execution and caused a LangChain parser to fail, directly connecting model behavior to integration difficulty. The results also limit the claim: GPT-4's agent performance improved, and removing non-code wrappers increased its code-test success from 52% to 70%, so behavioral change did not imply declining underlying capability.

evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Nelson F. Liu and colleagues
evidence_items.locator: Abstract; experimental methods and results in sections 3–5
evidence_items.explanation: Controlled changes to document order and context length impaired question answering across several model families, supporting consequential input sensitivity in a setup resembling retrieval-based products. Mitigations were task-dependent: placing the query before and after the data fixed the tested synthetic retrieval task but made little difference to the question-answering pattern.

evidence_items.locator: July 20, 2023 update, paragraph discussing evaluation metrics and model pinning
evidence_items.explanation: Version pinning was an available mitigation, so changes between releases do not establish unavoidable month-to-month drift within a fixed version. The same disclosure acknowledged application disruption from model changes; its stability statement concerns provider updates, not guaranteed correctness on every input.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not establish a universal instability level across all foundation models or product categories.
The studies demonstrate failure mechanisms but do not measure the total engineering effort required to achieve a specified production reliability target.
The long-context paper does not provide exact experiment dates; its event date is recorded only at year precision.
